description:
Binding AI-law obligations that started applying recently, newest first, with citation, official link and the
guard in one sentence.

When to use: someone asks what took effect recently, when the most recent AI law in a market started applying, or
what changed this year. For dates ahead, use coming_into_force. Features and markets narrow the list (each left
out covers everything); within_days sets how far back to look. Each date is when a duty started applying, not when
the law was enacted; a later phase of a law already in force is marked as one. Each entry's guard is the change to
make in the application (a notice, a check, a human review step). Returns at most 10, and `total` says how many
there are.
Limits: informational data, not legal advice.

features.description: The AI feature's integration patterns, any of: chat, rag, agentic, decision_pipeline (a model output that decides about a person), content_generation, classification, recommendation, embeddings. Omit it for every pattern.
features.title: Features

jurisdictions.description: Markets to cover, as codes: EU, a country code (GB, CN, KR, JP, BR, SG) or a US state as US-XX (US-CA, US-CO, US-NY); US matches every state. Omit it for every market.
jurisdictions.title: Jurisdictions

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10 (default 10); `total` in the answer says how many matched.
limit.title: Limit

within_days.description: How many days before today to look, 1 to 730 (default 180).
within_days.title: Within Days

name: recently_in_force
title: AI law recently in force
